cloud_annotations: Native Matplotlib reconstruction of the source projected vector paths, preserving point/shell geometry and ordering. No frame or ticks. Three-axis key projected from the source camera; labels aligned with shafts. Jason Momoa above Cannabis with separate leaders. Near/Far labels only; definitions in the caption.
scope: Cloud pools six datasets; near/far and pair tables use ten ConceptVectors concepts. External MiniLM embeddings, not LLM hidden states.
limits: Projection is illustrative; error bars are row-wise SEM, not cluster-adjusted confidence intervals.
